name: Husqvarna 350i
blurb: 18″ bar on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The 350i is a battery rear-handle saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists one approved combination: an 18″ bar, 3/8″ mini (low profile), .050″ gauge, 62 drive links, file 5/32″, chain S93G X-Cut 597469562, bar Laminate 597533262.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar Laminate 597533262 and chain S93G X-Cut 597469562. Pitch in the guide is 3/8 Mini, which is 3/8″ low profile. File size 5/32″.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 9 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
